verdict.failure_analysis: No hidden cases failed across the three trials. The rendered docs supported this task well: `Which processor should I use?` clearly recommends `WP_HTML_Tag_Processor` for flat, position-based tag/class edits; `Finding tags` and `next_tag()` document both string and array tag-name queries plus case-insensitive matching; `next_tag()` also explains that tag-like text inside comments and raw-text sections is not matched, which covers the comment case; `Bookmarks` and `set_bookmark()` explicitly describe re-setting the same bookmark name to remember the last matching tag; `seek()` documents returning to that bookmark; `add_class()` explains preserving existing classes and avoiding duplicates; and `get_updated_html()` explains how to retrieve the edited HTML while preserving untouched bytes.
